summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting on bondholders' meetings held August 18, 2026, to consider a merger proposal affecting domestic public debt bonds issued in 2010 and 2013. The 2010 meeting lacked quorum; the 2013 meeting achieved 15.33% quorum but failed to obtain the 80% outstanding principal approval required under Colombian Decree 2555. Second-call meetings will be scheduled, with notices to be published. The filing relates to a restructuring of debt as part of a merger process. What to watch: whether second-call quorum thresholds are lowered and bondholder approval is obtained.
